diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/completion_control.py b/src/evidence_harness/completion_control.py
index 0ab6141..326b1cb 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/completion_control.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/completion_control.py
@@ -154,7 +154,10 @@ class BudgetGuard:
         budget = contract.b_req
         reasons: list[str] = []
         remaining_calls = budget.max_environment_calls - state.counters.environment_calls
-        available_for_work = remaining_calls - budget.verification_environment_reserve
+        reserved_verification_calls = budget.verification_environment_reserve * (
+            budget.max_repairs + 1

+        available_for_work = remaining_calls - reserved_verification_calls
         if command_count > available_for_work:
             reasons.append("work command batch would consume the reserved verification calls")
         if budget.max_turns - state.counters.turns < 1:
